name: The William Vale
positioning: Contemporary hotel in Williamsburg, Brooklyn, where every room and suite has a private balcony over Brooklyn and the Manhattan skyline
best_for: Travelers who want Manhattan skyline views from a Brooklyn base one subway stop from Manhattan
Guests who want outdoor space: a private balcony, an elevated park and a seasonal pool or winter spa

facts.text: The William Vale is just steps from McCarren Park and the East River, in the center of Williamsburg, which the hotel calls Brooklyn's most creative neighborhood.
The L and G trains are a few blocks away, one stop from Manhattan.
The hotel takes its name from a 19th-century Brooklynite whose property boundaries encircled the site.
Rooms and suites have floor-to-ceiling windows, luxury linens and design-forward furnishings.
Room designs are sleek and modern, with pops of color sourced from local Brooklyn artists.
Suites include the Junior King Suite, the Manhattan View Corner Suite, the King One Bedroom Suite and the Vale Garden Residence.
The outdoor pool has poolside cabanas, daybeds and lounge chairs.
Williamsburg Beauty Spa, a family-owned neighborhood spa, is known for customized facials.
Guests can use The Malin Williamsburg coworking space with a day pass or meeting room booking at an exclusive rate.
Leuca serves Southern Italian food with handmade pasta and wood-fired pizza.
The rooftop bar Westlight is on the 22nd floor.

highlights.text: All guest rooms and suites have private balconies over Brooklyn and the Manhattan skyline.
The Manhattan View Corner Suite has a wraparound balcony.
Vale Park is an elevated green space with 15,000 square feet of landscaped gardens, open lawns and skyline views.
In the colder months, Winter Spa offers private panoramic barrel saunas and deep-soaking hot tubs.
Westlight offers 360-degree views over the Manhattan skyline, the East River and Williamsburg.

considerations.text: Vale Pool is a summer amenity and Winter Spa a cold-season one, so each is closed outside its season.
Westlight, Leuca, Little Fino and Vale Park welcome locals as well as hotel guests, and Vale Pool may offer public day passes in select seasons.
Pets are welcome, but a cleaning fee is added if a pet enters the room.
